description: Labeled retrieval-quality corpus for the IMP-037 local-lexical experience-recall provider. Documents become anchored lessons in a synthetic repository. Each query declares the document keys a correct provider must return within the result bound. Labels are declarative so a scoring change is reviewed as data, not buried in shell.

thresholds.comment: Measured 1.00/1.00 on the shipped local-lexical provider after the SCOPE-7 document-frequency guard and relevance floor were added (before them: precision 0.54, recall 1.00). Thresholds sit just under measured so benign scoring drift does not fail the gate while a real regression does. requirePerQueryFullRecall is the sharper guard: macro precision only falls to about 0.96 when a single query degrades, which a macro-only threshold could absorb, so every individual query must still return all of its labeled relevant records.

documents.problem: database connection timeout under retry storms
documents.cause: the retry budget was unbounded so every failure amplified
documents.fix: bound total retries and add jitter
documents.appliesWhen: a database timeout repeats under load

documents.problem: postgres connection pool exhaustion during migrations
documents.cause: long migrations held pooled connections open
documents.fix: run migrations on a dedicated short-lived connection
documents.appliesWhen: a migration runs against a pooled database

documents.problem: playwright end to end test flakes on the login redirect
documents.cause: the auth cookie was set after first paint so the assertion raced
documents.fix: wait for the network idle state before asserting the redirect
documents.appliesWhen: an end to end test asserts a post login redirect

documents.problem: end to end test passed while the feature was missing
documents.cause: the test returned early when the control was absent
documents.fix: assert visibility directly and delete the bailout branch
documents.appliesWhen: a required end to end scenario contains an early return

documents.problem: docker build cache miss on every cargo layer
documents.cause: the lockfile was copied after the source tree
documents.fix: copy manifests first and build dependencies before source
documents.appliesWhen: a docker build recompiles unchanged dependencies

documents.problem: docker build killed with exit code 137 during compilation
documents.cause: the host ran out of memory while other stacks were running
documents.fix: stop idle stacks and cap parallel compile jobs
documents.appliesWhen: a container build dies with exit code 137

documents.problem: a secret value leaked into terminal output during diagnostics
documents.cause: a masked expansion expanded to the real value when the variable was set
documents.fix: report presence only and never expand the value
documents.appliesWhen: a diagnostic prints a credential bearing variable

documents.problem: a commit swept in another agent's staged files
documents.cause: the shared index changed between the staging check and the commit
documents.fix: commit only explicit pathspecs so the index cannot leak in
documents.appliesWhen: several agents share one working copy

documents.problem: a shipped shell script landed without its executable bit
documents.cause: the file mode was never verified after creation
documents.fix: assert the staged mode rather than trusting the report
documents.appliesWhen: a new script is added to the managed file set

documents.problem: a new managed file was missing from the release manifest
documents.cause: the generator only walks tracked files and the file was untracked
documents.fix: stage the file before regenerating the manifest
documents.appliesWhen: a new managed file is added to the framework

documents.problem: a command substitution blocked for the full timeout after the command exited
documents.cause: the fallback watchdog inherited the caller's output pipe
documents.fix: detach the watchdog from the inherited pipe
documents.appliesWhen: a host has no coreutils timeout binary

documents.problem: a green selftest suite was executed by no quality gate
documents.cause: the validator registers selftests explicitly and nothing discovers them
documents.fix: register every new selftest in the validation entrypoint
documents.appliesWhen: a new selftest is added to the framework

queries.comment: A deliberately broad query. Both database documents are relevant, so this measures whether the provider can return a set rather than a single best guess.

nearMiss.comment: No corpus document covers this and no token is shared. A provider that returns anything here is pattern-matching noise.

Stopword-heavy filler. Every token is saturated across the corpus, including the template word 'problem', so the document-frequency guard must reduce this to no signal at all. Before that guard this query returned five confident hits.

Same technical register as the corpus but genuinely absent from it. One weak hit is permitted because 'cache' is a real shared token, and demanding zero here would over-fit the gate to this wording rather than measuring lexical behavior honestly.
